theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_lc_rc_massOn_restrict_univ
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (X.restrictDomain (subset_univ U)).massOn G ≤ X.massOn G ∧ (G ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ G → X (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω) = Z ω) → X.massOn G ≤ Z.massOn G)
